d: Saudi Gold Refinery (SGR) is a Saudi mining and precious-metals company specialized in the refining of gold and precious metals, bullion production, and value-added precious-metal services. Operating within the Kingdom’s mining value chain, SGR is aligned to the Vision 2030 mining pillar and to the regulatory framework set by the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources (MIM) and applicable Saudi and international standards. We produce responsibly sourced, traceable, and certified bullion, operate to LBMA Good Delivery and ISO-aligned quality standards, and invest in the people, processes, and controls behind every bar we produce.

Saudi Gold Refinery (SGR) is seeking a Project Manager in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia to lead capital infrastructure projects supporting our gold refining and bullion production operations. This role oversees the execution of brownfield expansions, laboratory upgrades, and security enhancements within a live industrial facility. The incumbent ensures all engineering works comply with SASO standards, MIM regulations, and internal HSE requirements.

The Project Manager will report directly to the Project Director and will play a key role in delivering strategic capacity improvements on time and within budget. This position requires strong commercial acumen and the ability to coordinate complex interfaces between contractors and operational teams.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, or Industrial) from an accredited institution.
Minimum of 15 years of project management experience in heavy industry, mining sectors.
PMP certification is mandatory to demonstrate professional project management competence.
Proven experience managing capital projects with budgets exceeding SAR 10 million.
Strong knowledge of FIDIC contracts and international construction standards.
Proficiency in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project for schedule management.
Fluency in English for technical reporting and international vendor communication.
Ability to work in Riyadh and travel to industrial sites within Saudi Arabia as needed.
Master’s degree in Project Management or Engineering Management.
Experience in precious metals refining or secure vault construction projects.
Project delivered within 5% of the approved budget baseline.
Zero lost-time injuries recorded during the project lifecycle.
Successful handover of as-built documentation to the maintenance team.
Positive stakeholder satisfaction scores from internal operations and HSE departments.
r: The Project Manager will execute the following key responsibilities to ensure successful project delivery.

The role develops comprehensive project execution plans that define scope, schedule, and resource requirements for capital initiatives. This includes establishing baseline metrics for tracking progress against strategic milestones.

This position monitors project expenditures against approved budgets by validating contractor invoices and tracking committed costs. It ensures financial discipline through regular forecasting and variance analysis reports.

The role manages EPC contractors and vendors by enforcing contractual obligations and performance standards. It resolves technical disputes and ensures deliverables meet SGR’s quality and safety specifications.

This position ensures all project activities adhere to Saudi Building Codes, SASO standards, and Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources regulations. It secures necessary permits and approvals from relevant government authorities.

The role integrates health, safety, and environmental requirements into daily construction activities to protect personnel and assets. It conducts regular site audits to verify compliance with ISO 45001 and SGR safety protocols.

This position facilitates communication between engineering teams, operations staff, and external consultants to align project goals. It manages expectations and resolves conflicts to maintain project momentum.

The role implements quality control procedures for civil, mechanical, and electrical works to ensure technical integrity. It reviews inspection test plans and verifies that materials meet specified standards.

This position leads the commissioning phase by coordinating functional tests and operational readiness checks. It ensures all systems are validated before handover to the maintenance and operations teams.
